name: Launch A — Reminder: We're LIVE

source.primary: At-start 'We're LIVE' — SMS-first with direct join URL.
supporting: Soap Opera Email #5 — urgency and CTA at zero hour.
Funnel Hacker's Cookbook — the live-now push is the last chance to convert intent into attendance.

purpose: One job: get them into the room now. SMS-first at start time with the direct join URL, plus one email for no-SMS contacts. No pitch, no context, no second CTA.

trigger.late_registrant_rule: Registered after start but while the session is live: send immediately once with honest copy ("we're live now"), provided the session has not ended.
requires: Custom field `webinar_end_datetime` (used to suppress after the session ends)

sms.body_framework: "We're LIVE — join now: [join URL]" plus host name. One line.

email.send: At start, to everyone; primary for no-SMS contacts
email.body_framework: One line that it has started, one join button. Nothing else.

copy_rules: Present tense only: it is happening now.
One line for SMS, under 60 words for email.
No price, no offer, no replay mention.
Do not send after `webinar_end_datetime`; a live link that points at an ended room trains people to ignore the next one.
guards: SMS DND or no consent -> email only.
Operator-started-late sessions: the live send follows the actual start, not the scheduled start, if the platform reports it.

ghl_build.structure: Trigger: Tag Added `webinar-registered` -> Wait until `webinar_datetime` -> If not purchased and now < `webinar_end_datetime` -> If SMS consent -> Send SMS -> Else -> Send Email -> End.
ghl_build.notes: The live send must be gated by the end datetime. A 'we're live' message after the room closed is the fastest way to burn the list.

scope.includes: Registered, not purchased, session currently live.
